      "evidence": "Documentation updates in doc/ are subordinate to the RPC feature implementation.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Non-member. The changes to documentation follow directly from the addition of UNIX socket support for RPC and do not constitute a standalone documentation improvement."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifications to netbase abstract socket addressing for local RPC and proxy connections without affecting P2P wire protocols, relay, or peer handling.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Non-member. While netbase socket abstractions are adjusted, P2P networking behavior and peer connections are not modified."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Tagged RPC/REST/ZMQ; modifies httpserver.cpp, bitcoin-cli.cpp, and functional RPC tests to support UNIX domain sockets via -rpcbind= and -rpcconnect=.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds long-requested UNIX domain socket support for local RPC connections and bitcoin-cli, resolving issue #5029 from 2014. This provides meaningful user and ecosystem value by avoiding TCP loopback overhead and enabling standard filesystem permissions for access control."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Framework test updates in test_node.py and authproxy.py merely support test coverage for the new RPC socket functionality.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Non-member. Changes in the test framework exist solely to exercise the new RPC UNIX socket binding and do not represent improvements to testing infrastructure itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/init.cpp and netbase socket utilities are subordinate to the RPC server implementation.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Non-member. The refactoring of SocketAddr and Proxy abstractions in netbase serves to support HTTP server bindings and resolve tech debt from #27375 rather than altering general node utility infrastructure."
    }
  ],

    "leverage": 1
  }
}
